headline: Android adds AI defenses against messaging scams
summary: Google is rolling out Gemini-powered Android features that warn users about scam messages, protect banking details while screen-sharing, and defend against call-forwarding abuse.

claims.statement: Google is rolling out AI (Gemini) features on Android to warn users about scam messages.

sources.quote: Android will use Gemini to warn you about scammy messages
Android gets AI defenses against messaging scams, fake calls

claims.statement: The feature protects banking details from prying eyes while a user is sharing their screen.

sources.quote: Google will tell if you a scammer is trying to message you and will protect your banking details from prying eyes while sharing your screen

claims.statement: The update also defends against call-forwarding abuse, rolling out to eligible devices.

sources.quote: Google announced new AI-powered defenses against scam messages and call-forwarding abuse on Android, currently rolling out to eligible devices.
